textField:
To find a sprite's horizontal position, we need to check its *X* coordinate.
When a rock is falling straight down from the ceiling, its *Y* coordinate is changing.
The math sign that means "less than" looks like this: *<*.
The X-axis goes from left to right, starting at *-240* and ending at *240*.
The Y-axis goes from the bottom to the top, starting at -180 and ending at *180*.
If a car is driving on the right side of the screen, its X position will be *greater* than 0.
To make a star appear anywhere on the screen, we can set its X and Y blocks to pick *random* numbers.
To check if a sprite has fallen off the very bottom of the screen, we can check if its Y position is *less* than -170.
